answer: A hundred masks, one question: can the applicant show each sweet muscat is a year of cellar logs in the wine ledger under Bin keeper sweet muscat mark racked in the tasting parlour? Every proof carries its date, so a proof painted yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old. The vertex says who, the summit says how much, the ember says how long — and of the three, the farm fears the last answer most. Farm 324 masks as a business and the ledger shows a single expense, 20088 POA locked away, and zero revenue. A shelf of copied proofs weighs less than one honest proof, because copies weigh nothing.
